description: The Kitchen's north-west corner cut off by a wall W11, 2' east for every 3' north, with a 2' window O2 in it, and a string along [1, -1] across the corner, through the middle of W11, from its outside face to O2's centre, its inside face and J3: every position irrational - sqrt(13) from the wall, sqrt(2) from the direction - and each length rounded once, as an independent computation in 60-digit decimals finds.
